verses.1: And Jacob set foot on the land of the children of Edom.
verses.2: And he saw in the field, and there were three sheepherders grazing there. For from that stream, the sheep would drink water. And the tree was very tall, due to the abundance of water from that stream.
verses.3: And all the flocks gathered together. They removed the stone from over the well, filled the troughs with water, and placed the stone back in its place.
verses.4: And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, from where do you come?” They replied, “From Haran we come.”
verses.5: And he said to them, “Do you know Lavan son of Nahor?” They replied, “Yes, we know him.”
verses.6: And he said to them, “Be happy.” They said, “We are happy.” And then Rachel, his daughter, came along with the lamb.
verses.7: And they said, “Today is a day of great importance. It’s not the time to gather up the goods and go away.”
verses.8: And they said, “We cannot do this until all the tribes have gathered together, and they have removed the stone from over the well. Then we can fill the jar.”
verses.9: We continued to talk with them. Then Rachel came along with the lamb that belonged to her father, because it was his property.
verses.10: And when Jacob saw Rachel, his sister’s daughter, and her sheep, he rushed over and put the stone away from the mouth of the well. Then he stroked the sheep of his sister’s daughter.
verses.11: And Jacob hugged Rachel, and he held her in his arms.
verses.12: And Jacob told Rebekah that his brother was her father’s son, and that he was the son of Rebekah. Then she became upset and told her father about it.
verses.13: And when Laban heard about his son Jacob, he rushed to meet him. He hugged and comforted him, and brought him into his house. Then he told Laban all these things.
verses.14: And Laban said to him, “But I, and with my words, you shall be with him for six more days.”
verses.15: And Laban said to Jacob, “Why, my brother, you serve me. Tell me, what is your wages?”
verses.16: And Loleban had two daughters: the elder one was named Leah, and the younger one was named Rahel.
verses.17: And Leah’s eyes were beautiful, and Rachel was also beautiful in appearance.
verses.18: And Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you for seven years. You are my younger daughter.”
verses.19: And Laban said, “It’s good that I give her to you. I’ll give her to another man instead. She shall be with him.”
verses.20: And Jacob served Rachel for seven years. During those years, he remained in her love as if it were just one day.
verses.21: And Jacob said to Laban, “Please give me my wife back, for my days are nearly over, and I will go see her.”
verses.22: And Laban gathered all the people from that place, and made them into slaves.
verses.23: In the morning, he took Leah, his daughter, and brought her to him.
verses.24: And Laban gave Leah his maid as a wife for his son Jacob.
verses.25: And in the morning, he saw that it was two days. He said to Laban, “What have you done to me? I have served you with Rahab. Why have you deceived me?”
verses.26: And Laban said, “It should not be done in our place. It is better to present the young woman before the bridegroom.”
verses.27: And this will be multiplied, and you will also receive this in exchange for the work you will do alongside me. This work will last for another seven years.
verses.28: And Jacob did as he was told. He married Rachel, his daughter, to her.
verses.29: And Laban gave Rachel his daughter in marriage to her as a wife.
verses.30: And he also went to Rachel. He loved Rachel deeply. He served her for another seven years.
verses.31: And Jehovah saw that it was necessary to have a change, so He opened His mercy. And Rachel became pregnant.
verses.32: And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuven, because she said, “Now, God will love me again, for now He will cherish me.”
verses.33: And she became pregnant again, and gave birth to a son. She said, “Since Jehovah has heard my prayers, he has given me this child as well.” Then she named him Shimeon.
verses.34: And she got up again and gave birth to a son. She said, “Now, for once, someone will come to me. After all, I have given birth to three sons. Therefore, I named him Levi.”
verses.35: And she became pregnant again. She gave birth to a son. This time, she said, “I will call upon Jehovah for help.” So she named her son Yehuda. Then she stood by the door.
